senses.gloss: (b. h. נשׂר, a. שׂוּר; cmp. סער a. שׂער) [to produce a rough, grating sound; cmp. גָּרַר I,] to saw, plane.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6:7">Gen. R. s. 6</cite> <he>כמסר הזה שהוא נוֹסֵר בעץ</he> (the light of the sun produces a sound) like (that of) the plane which planes wood, opp. <he>שף</he> to glide; Midr. Sam. ch. IX.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:22">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>עד שהחמה נוֹסֶרֶת ברקיע וכ׳</he> while the sun passes in the sky a journey of &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8">Gen. R. s. 8</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>, beg. <he>נְסָרוֹ וכ׳</he> he sawed him apart &c., v. <cite ref="C00031"><he>גַּב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 20b:10">Yoma 20ᵇ</cite> <he>גלגל חמה שמְנַסֵּר ברקיע וכ׳</he> the globe of the sun which saws in the sky like a carpenter sawing cedars, v. supra.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>, end <he>נתנו … והיו מְנַסְּרִים בו</he> they placed him on a sawing-jack (v. <cite ref="H01163"><he>חֲמוֹר</he></cite>) and sawed his body; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:10">B. Kam. X, 10</cite> <he>נִסָּרוֹת</he>, <he>נִסָּרִים</he>, v. <cite ref="N00921"><he>נְסוֹרֶת</he></cite>.
